summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting earnings for Q1 fiscal 2026 and issuing a press release. The filing details unaudited financial results: revenue of $28.2 million (up 55% YoY), positive operating cash flow of $6.6 million (a $17.3 million improvement), and cash balance of $98.4 million (up 373% YoY). The company raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $160-200 million. Reported IFRS operating loss of $41.1 million is attributed to non-cash stock-based compensation and FX losses. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
